desc: Ideation: reduction to ternary tree, pair-cost DP, "sum of bases + two smallest extras" recurrence.
Parse N and the binary string A from stdin.
Compute L = 3^N and initialize leaf cost arrays: cost0/cost1 per leaf from each character.
Implement bottom-up level-by-level DP combining triples with cost_v = sum_i c_i(v) - max_i max(0, c_i(v)-c_i(1-v)).
Extract answer as max(root_cost0, root_cost1) since the original root value costs 0.
Output the DP cost and verify on samples 1 and 2 (both PASSED).
